title: Standing work, a test: iron at Schedar Belt (beyond the border, one jump from Node Beta) into storage at Node Beta
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-16 23:24 UTC (orders.log ENT-019, block ZERO: iron for the reserve on fields that hold, each with a floor; a field beyond our space is mine to test, rule F3). The shared iron routes gather-gsc-0027-prism-scatter and gather-hamal-crystal-bloom stood full (66/66, 76/76) while miners waited (fill.py status, 23:19 UTC). Schedar Belt holds iron 72,876 (richness 57) and copper 99,970 (richness 44), census 23:01 UTC; iron fell 74,535 -> 72,876 from 13:34 to 23:02 UTC, so another miner works it. Schedar is lawless, one jump from Node Beta (lanes). Pilots of other factions were met at other places of the system, a combat drone among them at 14:22 UTC (data/intel/met.json). A test: one ship, empty hold, until its first RESULT line is read (rule F13). 2026-11-17 00:19 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 1 -> 2. 2026-11-17 00:25 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 2 -> 4. 2026-11-17 00:27 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 4 -> 1. Lifted from 1 to 10 by Zero, 2026-11-17 03:11 UTC: the field read 71,620 iron (richness 57) and 99,902 copper at 03:07 UTC, 41,620 iron above the floor; two runs of one ship, 221 and about 200 ore in 45 minutes into Node Beta, -160 cr a run of fuel (data/routes/runs.jsonl); the one stranger met there in six hours flies a starter hull like ours and was never in combat (table met, 02:47 UTC). Ten ships take about 1,800 iron an hour against 41,620 above the floor: the floor holds for this turn and longer. Lifted from 10 to 15 by Zero, 2026-11-17 03:17 UTC: ten ships took the ten places within two minutes while 22 miners waited (fill.py status, 03:15 UTC); 141,522 units above the floor, 41,620 of them iron; 15 ships take about 2,500 iron an hour. 2026-11-17 05:52 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 15 -> 45. 2026-11-17 07:12 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-029, task 4 a): floor {"iron_ore": 30000} -> 20,000 iron, because the game says a depleted deposit refills gradually in proportion to its capacity (game/rules/13-not-stated.md, from mining.md), and our reads agree: Hamal grew back about 360 iron an hour at 31,000, Ironhollow Fading Signal 413 at 52,551, Echo Ejecta 312 near 97,000 (hive.py refill, read.db readings); a higher floor buys no faster regrowth, only a stock left for later, and iron is short 298,708 (the tool stock, view=reserve, 07:03 UTC). lift_to 45: the guard of Military is sized for up to 45 ships here (orders ENT-029, block APOPHIS); 57,479 iron at 06:48 UTC. 2026-11-23 05:37 UTC (Zero): back into the miner plan, the list Then before the jump loop, max_ships 4, lift_to 10 (orders ENT-076 P1, block ZERO; rules F8, F23, F36). Schedar Belt read 74,491 copper and 73,875 iron at 05:10 UTC (table fields). Copper ore is no good of the reserve (pull.py levels 05:37 UTC), so the pull rule leaves this gather open while iron stands full; it is the Mining skill's work for the Voidborn miners whose reserve gathers are full and who hold Piloting 10 (train-jumps-miner refuses them), at a gather's fuel instead of the jump loop's (-488 cr a ship-hour, briefing 05:16 UTC). min_left keeps the floor; the dispatcher's pirate stop reads its place. 2026-11-23 06:20 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 4 -> 5. 2026-11-23 06:30 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 5 -> 7. 2026-11-23 08:22 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 7 -> 9. 2026-11-23 10:03 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 9 -> 10. 2026-11-23 12:09 UTC (Zero): gift to the hauler receivers at Node Beta Industrial Station (handover.py): each run stores its hold there and hands the iron, copper and reserve ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to Logistics' docked steel, so no separate give run follows (give-miner-stores-node-beta flew 44 runs for -3,601 cr in the 4 hours to 11:25 UTC, table runs); nothing sold (P5).
